_about: bd-bfagiy: one case table for every school search in the portal. Read by the server tests (tests/portal/bd-bfagiy-school-search.test.js, over bot/shared/utils/school-search.js) and the portal tests (portal/src/portal/lib/schoolSearch.test.ts, over schoolSearch.ts), so the two copies of the rule cannot drift. Each case: the query typed, and the ids that must come back, best first.

cases.why: the operator's I-10/3 with no punctuation; a name starting with it first
spaces between the parts; IMCB G-10/3 holds i, 10 and 3 too, but only apart, so it is left out while I-10/3 itself is there
words found apart count when nothing holds the query whole
no school holds it whole and none holds both words: nothing
two words, each found in the name
the start of an EMIS code
part of a name, punctuation ignored
words from anywhere in the name
Urdu words are kept, the space between them ignored
a blank search shows every school, in the list's own order
only spaces and punctuation is a blank search
